program.name: Yin Volume
program.subject: Yin yoga
program.blurb: Three long yin practices: the hips, the spine, then legs and shoulders.
program.about: Long, quiet yin practices of a few poses held for minutes each. Dragon, frog and sleeping swan open the hips; caterpillar, saddle and melting heart the spine; shoelace, square and deer the legs and shoulders. Three days rotate and each ends in a long rest. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
